description: This Java class implements the service for processing amortization of buy-down fees on loan accounts, including handling amortization till a date, on loan closure, charge off, and undo charge off. It interacts with repositories, creates transactions, posts journal entries, and publishes business events.

classes.name: LoanBuyDownFeeAmortizationProcessingServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of service for processing buy-down fee amortizations on loans, managing different loan states and transactions, and publishing related business events.

methods.name: processBuyDownFeeAmortizationTillDate
methods.description: Processes amortization of buy-down fees on a loan up to a specified date, creating or adjusting transactions, updating balances, posting journal entries, and publishing events.

methods.name: processBuyDownFeeAmortizationOnLoanClosure
methods.description: Handles amortization at the time of loan closure, creating a transaction and publishing relevant business events.

methods.name: processBuyDownFeeAmortizationOnLoanChargeOff
methods.description: Handles amortization when a loan is charged off, creating transactions, posting journal entries, and publishing events.

methods.name: processBuyDownFeeAmortizationOnLoanUndoChargeOff
methods.description: Reverses amortization related to a charge-off, reversing transactions, resetting balances, posting journal entries, and publishing events.

methods.name: createBuyDownFeeAmortizationTransaction
methods.description: Creates a buy-down fee amortization transaction for a loan, including handling of balances, adjustments, and linking to charge-off transactions if applicable.

methods.name: getFinalBuyDownFeeAmortizationTransactionDate
methods.description: Determines the final transaction date for amortization based on the loan's status.
